newsitem.title: USA: DeKalb backs upper end of EPS range.
newsitem.headline: DeKalb backs upper end of EPS range.

text.p: DeKalb Genetics Corp said Thursday it is comfortable with fiscal 1997 earnings estimates in the upper end of a range of $1.35 to $1.60 a share.
"Analyst estimates of our fiscal 1997 earnings range from $1.35 to $1.60, and we are comfortable with the upper end of that range," Bruce Bickner, chairman, said in a statement.
He added the company now expects to reach its year-2000 goal of 15 percent return on equity this year.
Earlier, DeKalb reported second quarter earnings of $0.91 a share, up from $0.61 a year ago.
For the first six months, it earned $1.03 a share, up from $0.61 a year ago.

"Both our North American and international seed businesses are showing continued improvement," Bickner said. "North American seed revenue was up nine percent during the first half, and all indications are that DeKalb will have both a higher North American corn market share in 1997 and improved corn unit margins."
North American seed segment earnings were $23.3 million for the six months, up 51 percent from $15.4 million last year. Revenues rose to $162.4 million from $149.1 million.
For the six months, international segment earnings were $12.1 million, up 68 percent from $7.2 million last year, while revenues increased 20 percent to $69.2 million.
"Customer demand exceeded supply for DeKalb products in Argentina this season, leading to significant revenue and profitability increases," Richard Ryan, president, said in a statement.

He added that DeKalb's joint venture in Mexico also produced strong results. "Both corn and sorghum sales are ahead of last year's pace, thanks to strong product performance," he said. "We also are benefiting from continued improvements in operations and an improved economy."

Six-month segment earnings for DeKalb Swine Breeders fell to $600,000 compared with $700,000 last year due to higher feed costs. Revenues rose 18 percent to $27.8 million from $23.6 million, due to higher market hog prices.
